signals.usability_note: Shows the side of a white-sided house with an attached sunroom, seen from the sidewalk across a lawn and stone retaining wall. Heavy tree canopy blocks the roofline and much of the upper facade.
signals.notes: A car is parked in the distant driveway on the left. Trash bins and a blue item sit beside the house, and a large boulder and mature shade tree are in the front yard, so the lawn looks homeowner-maintained.
